summary: Activision's arcade skateboarding series built around Tony Hawk, covering the Pro Skater classics, Underground/American Wasteland era, HD experiments, peripheral games, mobile spin-offs, and modern remakes.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater

emulation.notes: Native Windows remake route; DuckStation/Redream optional for historical comparison.

primary.why: The 2020 remake rebuilds the first game in HD with modern controls, online features, and the restored Pro Skater 1 level set, making it the highest-fidelity main route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2 on Windows or current PC storefront; use the original PlayStation/Dreamcast/N64 versions only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document soundtrack differences and remake physics if comparing to original hardware.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
entries.definitive_edition: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2 remake plus Pro Skater 2x exclusive-level secondary

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Xemu optional for Pro Skater 2x
emulation.notes: Use native Windows remake for the main route; use Xbox hardware/Xemu for 2x exclusive levels.

primary.why: The 2020 remake rebuilds Pro Skater 2 in HD and is the highest-fidelity route for its level/objective set.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2 on Windows; preserve Pro Skater 2x separately for its Xbox-exclusive levels.

secondary.exclusive_content: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x includes five original Xbox-exclusive levels in addition to THPS1/2 content.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the five Pro Skater 2x original levels only.
secondary.why: Pro Skater 2x is a distinct Xbox re-release with exclusive levels.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document soundtrack and physics differences when comparing remake/original/2x.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x

emulation.notes: Use Xemu only after compatibility verification; original Xbox hardware is the baseline.

primary.why: Pro Skater 2x is an Xbox-only enhanced release with five original levels, so Xbox hardware or Xemu is the only route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or Xemu; focus on the five exclusive levels if the THPS1/2 remake is already the main route.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is not replaced by the 1 + 2 remake because of its exclusive original levels.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3

emulation.notes: Native Windows remake route.

primary.why: The 2025 remake is the current highest-fidelity route for Pro Skater 3 content across PC and current platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 on Windows; use the original PC/PS2/GameCube/Xbox releases only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document remake soundtrack, roster, and physics differences.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4
entries.definitive_edition: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 remake plus original THPS4 secondary comparison

emulation.emulator: None for primary; PCSX2/Dolphin/Xemu optional for original structure
emulation.notes: Use native Windows remake first; original PC/console versions for career-structure comparison.

primary.why: The 2025 remake is the highest-fidelity route for Pro Skater 4 levels, but the original mission/NPC career structure should be preserved separately.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4 on Windows, then use the original PC or PS2/GameCube/Xbox release if comparing the original THPS4 mission structure.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Pro Skater 4 career structure and contextual NPC mission flow.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample or complete original THPS4 career if documenting design differences from the remake.
secondary.why: Reviews and previews of the 2025 remake note THPS4 structure changes; the original remains necessary for the original mission format.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document THPS4 structural changes in the remake.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Underground

emulation.notes: Native Windows route.

primary.why: The Windows port is the highest-fidelity route for Underground's story campaign, ahead of sixth-generation consoles and handheld/mobile adaptations.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with compatibility fixes; use console versions only for baseline comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; document compatibility and music licensing state.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Underground 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release plus PSP Remix secondary

emulation.emulator: None for primary; PPSSPP for Remix
emulation.notes: Use native Windows for main campaign; PPSSPP for Remix-exclusive content.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the main Underground 2 campaign, while Underground 2 Remix on PSP adds extra levels.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version for the main campaign, then play Underground 2 Remix on PPSSPP for its extra levels.

secondary.exclusive_content: Underground 2 Remix adds extra levels and PSP-specific content.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the Remix-exclusive levels in PPSSPP.
secondary.why: The PSP Remix release is a distinct expanded version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; document Remix differences separately.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's American Wasteland

emulation.notes: Native Windows route.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the main American Wasteland release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with compatibility fixes; archive American Sk8land separately because it is a distinct handheld branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; document soundtrack/version state.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's American Sk8land

emulation.notes: Use melonDS or original DS hardware.

primary.why: American Sk8land is a distinct handheld companion to American Wasteland; the DS version is the fuller handheld route compared with GBA.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Nintendo DS version in melonDS or on original hardware; use the GBA version only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Project 8
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox 360 version plus PSP Classic Mode secondary

emulation.notes: Prefer Xbox hardware/backward compatibility for primary; PPSSPP for PSP Classic Mode.

primary.why: The Xbox 360/PS3 versions use the new HD engine; Xbox 360 is the cleaner recommendation because the PS3 version was criticized for unstable performance and lacked online functionality.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version on Xbox hardware/backward compatibility; use PSP only for its Classic Mode if desired.

secondary.exclusive_content: PSP version includes an additional Classic Mode with goals in levels from past Tony Hawk games.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the PSP Classic Mode only.
secondary.why: The PSP version has an exclusive Classic Mode.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; document version-family differences.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Downhill Jam

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin with documented motion/control mapping.

primary.why: Downhill Jam was built around the Wii/DS/GBA branch; the Wii version is the highest-fidelity main version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Wii version on Dolphin or Wii hardware; archive DS/GBA as handheld adaptations.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Proving Ground

emulation.notes: Prefer Xbox hardware/backward compatibility; Xenia only after compatibility verification.

primary.why: Proving Ground's HD console versions are the best main route; Xbox 360/backward compatibility is the cleanest recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version on Xbox hardware/backward compatibility; use Wii/DS only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Motion

emulation.notes: Use emulator only if motion peripheral behavior is supported and documented.

primary.why: Motion is a Nintendo DS game built around a motion-sensing peripheral, so original DS hardware is the proper route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo DS hardware with the Motion Pack peripheral; emulation is not a reliable primary route unless the sensor behavior is specifically supported.

entries.remaster_caveats: Requires DS Motion Pack peripheral for authentic play.

entries.title: Tony Hawk: Ride

emulation.notes: Original hardware/peripheral required.

primary.why: Ride requires the skateboard controller; Xbox 360/PS3 are the highest-fidelity versions, with Xbox 360 the simplest primary target.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 with the required skateboard peripheral; document peripheral calibration and condition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Peripheral condition and calibration are core archival variables.

entries.title: Tony Hawk: Shred

emulation.notes: Original hardware/peripheral required.

primary.why: Shred also depends on the skateboard controller; Xbox 360 is the cleanest HD route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 with the required skateboard peripheral; document peripheral calibration and condition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Peripheral condition and calibration are core archival variables.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater HD

emulation.notes: Native Windows route.

primary.version: PC release with Revert Pack DLC
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the 2012 HD reinterpretation, including the Revert Pack DLC if available.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with Revert Pack content installed where available; document delisting/storefront status.

entries.remaster_caveats: Superseded for THPS1/2 content by the 2020 remake, but still a distinct 2012 release.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 5

emulation.notes: Native Xbox hardware route.

primary.why: Pro Skater 5 never released on PC; Xbox One is the best practical current-hardware route among its console releases.
primary.how_to_play: Play the patched Xbox One version on Xbox One or Series hardware; document patch availability because launch versions were heavily criticized.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC release; document patch/build state.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Skate Jam

emulation.notes: Use emulator only with documented app version.

primary.why: Skate Jam was a mobile Tony Hawk game released for Android and iOS; Android is the more practical preservation target.
primary.how_to_play: Preserve and play the Android build on compatible hardware/emulation where legally available; document delisting/service state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile preservation entry; document app version and storefront status.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2

emulation.notes: Native Windows route.

primary.why: The remake collection is best on Windows for fidelity, settings, and preservation while also covering the first two Pro Skater games.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam/Epic/Battle.net as available; document patch, storefront, and soundtrack state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document soundtrack/licensing and online-service state.

entries.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4

emulation.notes: Native Windows route.

primary.why: The 2025 remake collection is newest and best on Windows for fidelity, settings, and long-term capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows via Steam, Battle.net, Microsoft Store, or PC Game Pass; document patch, edition, and any Deluxe/Collector content such as Doom bonus skaters.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document edition bonuses, soundtrack, roster, and THPS4 structure changes.
